title.narrative: Multi-country Caribbean strategic response towards HIV/TB elimination in the region - Caribbean - Multicountry Caribbean MCC (01-Apr-2025-31-Dec-2027)

description.narrative: Multicountry Caribbean MCC, TB/HIV, Caribbean Vulnerable Communities (CVC)This program has the following goals: Establish seamlessly integrated, person-centred healthcare services that prioritize the health and well-being of persons living with HIV and key populations by ensuring access to a comprehensive package of services including combination prevention and differentiated service delivery for treatment and management of STIs, TB and NCDs.. The objectives of this program are: To increase the number of key populations accessing differentiated prevention, testing and treatment services.. To continue implementation of the TB elimination framework for low incidence countries to accelerate the elimination of TB in the OECS.. To increase access to quality laboratory testing, screening and diagnosis for the clinical management of HIV, TB, STIs and NCDs.. To strengthen the integration of HIV, STI and TB programs into primary health care to ensure that comprehensive, high quality care is provided for individuals co-infected with HIV, TB and STIs.. To improve HIV/STI /TB surveillance systems to increase the availability of data to support evidence-based planning, measure the impact of the response and the achievement of targets.. To strengthen the health and community systems response to address human rights and gender inequality barriers.
